name: Sarah, club captain
text: Biscuit tin here too. Ours had a custard cream in it. Every word of this is our club.

name: Anonymous
text: I'm always in the bottom half. Always. I've started to take it personally.

author: jake
text: Malcolm, try running the next one as a [knockout comp on Rallio](https://rallio.io/competitions/). You seed the field and it spreads the byes across both halves, then everyone gets the draw on their phone. You can still do it in the bar if you like, just without the hat.

name: Phil T
text: The seeding argument is the best part of the year. Don't take that away from us.
